title: Aortic stenosis

patient.name: Mohan
patient.chief_complaint: I get breathless and feel a tightness in my chest when I climb stairs.
patient.history: Gradually worsening breathlessness on exertion over 8 months. Two episodes of nearly fainting while walking uphill. Chest tightness on effort that settles with rest. Hypertension, on amlodipine. No smoking history.

chest_r2ics.description: Harsh crescendo-decrescendo systolic ejection murmur, loudest at the aortic area, radiating towards the carotids. Soft S2.

chest_apex.description: S1 normal, systolic murmur audible but softer.

chest_l2ics.description: Systolic murmur, softer than aortic area.

teaching_points: Auscultate with the patient leaning forward in held expiration.
Check slow-rising pulse and narrow pulse pressure.
